atlas.name: Schaefer local-global parcellation (Schaefer et al. 2018)
atlas.description: Cortical parcels obtained from resting-state functional connectivity of 1489 subjects, combining local gradients and global similarity. Each parcel is assigned to one of the Yeo 7 networks; the parcel name is network, approximate location and index.

reference.text: Schaefer A et al. (2018). Local-global parcellation of the human cerebral cortex from intrinsic functional connectivity MRI. Cereb Cortex 28, 3095-3114.

atlas.data_source: fsLR 32k dlabel files (7-network order) from the CBIG GitHub repository (ThomasYeoLab/CBIG).
atlas.note: Parcels show the description of their network. Location abbreviations in parcel names (e.g. pCunPCC, IPL) are from the Schaefer et al. 2018 label files.

Vis.location: Occipital lobe and posterior temporal/parietal cortex.

SomMot.location: Pre- and postcentral gyri, extending into auditory cortex.
SomMot.function: Motor and somatosensory cortex; auditory cortex is included in the 7-network solution.

DorsAttn.location: Intraparietal sulcus, superior parietal lobule, frontal eye fields and MT+.
DorsAttn.function: Top-down, goal-directed control of spatial attention.

references.text: Corbetta M, Shulman GL (2002). Control of goal-directed and stimulus-driven attention in the brain. Nat Rev Neurosci 3, 201-215.

SalVentAttn.location: Temporo-parietal junction, ventral frontal cortex, anterior insula and dorsal anterior cingulate.
SalVentAttn.function: Stimulus-driven reorienting of attention and salience detection.

references.text: Seeley WW et al. (2007). Dissociable intrinsic connectivity networks for salience processing and executive control. J Neurosci 27, 2349-2356.

Limbic.function: Functionally heterogeneous; fMRI signal here suffers from susceptibility artefacts, so boundaries are less reliable.

Cont.location: Lateral prefrontal cortex, anterior inferior parietal lobule and part of the precuneus.

references.text: Vincent JL et al. (2008). Evidence for a frontoparietal control system revealed by intrinsic functional connectivity. J Neurophysiol 100, 3328-3342.

Default.location: Medial prefrontal cortex, posterior cingulate/precuneus, angular gyrus and lateral temporal cortex.
Default.function: More active at rest than during externally directed tasks; linked to self-referential thought, memory retrieval and mental simulation.

references.text: Raichle ME et al. (2001). A default mode of brain function. PNAS 98, 676-682.
